# 3ngram v1.6.1

Patch: closes the last erasure race on the session-lifecycle surface, and the
release pipeline now publishes the worker image.

## Changes

- **Session opens refuse erased accounts** (#197). `openSession` took only the
  session-attach lock and never consulted the account-deletion tombstone, so
  an authenticated `/open` in flight during erasure could INSERT a fresh
  `agent_sessions` row — selector, `briefed_memories` and all — after the
  bulk redaction that is documented as the account's final content write. It
  now takes the account-lifecycle advisory lock in **shared** mode and
  re-checks the tombstone under it as its first statement, throwing
  `AccountDeletedError`; REST maps it to `410 account_deleted` (previously an
  unmapped 500). Shared mode is the point: opens serialize against erasure,
  never against each other.

  The fix also hoists the heartbeat's shared-lock acquisition above the
  attach lock on the excerpt path — the two locks were requested in opposite
  orders, which would have closed a three-party deadlock cycle the moment an
  erasure queued its exclusive request between them. Excerpt-free heartbeats
  still take no account-lifecycle lock.

- **Worker image published per release** (#200). `ghcr.io/b3dmar/3ngram-worker`
  now ships alongside the server image with the same supply chain: amd64+arm64
  Trivy scans, max-mode provenance, SBOM, registry-pushed attestation, and an
  anonymous-pull verification. The `@3ngram/worker` npm package stays private;
  the image is the only published artifact. Worker identity labels are
  asserted at publish time so the image carries its own OCI title/description
  rather than the server's.

- **Worker deployment documented** — `docs/operate.mdx` topology grows to four
  portable pieces, `docs/container-image.mdx` gains the worker-image section
  (env contract including the non-obvious production `OAUTH_JWKS` requirement,
  tracked for relaxation in #204; PID-only liveness caveats), and the
  `SESSION_CLOSER_ENABLED` kill switch is exposed in both env templates.

No migrations. Schema head stays at `0036_triage_armed_at`. Both triage
mechanisms (`SESSION_CLOSER_ENABLED`, `THREENGRAM_STOP_NUDGE`) remain
**default-off** pending the #166 validation bar.
